notes: the three compiler's shaykhs («حدثني أبو كريب ... والقاسم ... وعبد بن حميد قالوا») share one level
Nu'aym's «رأيت أبا هريرة يتوضأ» is a narrated encounter: Abu Hurayra is linked as the last transmitter because his words («هكذا رأيت رسول الله») are relayed, but the rules leave an observed act open
the Prophet's saying after «وقال قال رسول الله» has no isnad of its own and is not a second route
